summary: Teaches adding team, service.name and env remote attributes to collectors in Grafana Fleet Management.

needs.description: At least two (ideally several) collectors registered and visible in Fleet Management Inventory (/a/grafana-collector-app/fleet-management), checkable and bulk-editable.
needs.evidence: Before you begin: "More than one collector registered in Fleet Management"; select-collector: select checkboxes

needs.description: Admin or Fleet Management RBAC permissions to edit remote attributes.
needs.evidence: Before you begin: "Admin or RBAC permissions"

reviewNotes: Collectors are real Alloy instances (or simulated via Fleet Management API pipeline) outside the stack; seeding via collector registration API could be possible but is unconfirmed. Path mutates collector attributes.
